key_results: CycleGAN variant (CUT) translated frozen sections to FFPE-like images; visual Turing test 60.2% accuracy; GenFFPE reassessment increased diagnostic concordance by 53.3% in 55 discrepant cases
comments: Clinically promising but the 60.2% visual Turing test indicates substantial remaining artifacts; external validation limited to skin cancer types.

model_io.model: CycleGAN, CUT, AIFFPE, SANTA unpaired image-to-image models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative AI can translate frozen sections to FFPE-quality images without paired training data
hypotheses.result: Supported: CUT achieved best fidelity; improved diagnostic concordance for challenging tumors

title: OCPP integrated artificial intelligence for forecasting scheduling and anomaly detection in city scale electric vehicle charging under urban tariffs
task: OCPP-integrated AI for EV charging scheduling and anomaly detection
key_results: Hybrid GA+Q-learning reduces feeder peak 8.2% and charging cost 8.2%; CNN anomaly detection ROC AUC 0.914; system latency <0.1 s; operates on commodity hardware at 15-minute intervals
comments: Well-engineered standards-compliant system (OCPP 1.6/2.0.1) with practical real-time constraints; fairness mechanism prevents user delays, but limited ablation of fairness vs. optimality trade-off.

model_io.model: Forecasting (short-horizon), GA + Q-learning scheduling, CNN + Autoencoder + Isolation Forest anomaly detection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tariff-aware and fairness-aware scheduling reduces grid peak and charging cost without excessive user delays
hypotheses.result: Hybrid GA+Q-learning achieved 8.2% peak and cost reduction with fairness constraint enforcement

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN detects charger anomalies from telemetry patterns
hypotheses.result: CNN achieved ROC AUC 0.914; Autoencoder and Isolation Forest lower at 0.735 and 0.636

title: Proactive detection of voice phishing networks using call log analysis and machine learning
task: Proactive voice phishing network detection from call metadata
key_results: Gradient boosting and MLP exceed 95% accuracy and 97% recall; random forest achieves similar performance; identified key behavioral predictors (weekday concentration, short duration, high outgoing ratio, MVNO preference)
comments: Strong empirical performance on real-world Korean telecom data; however, limited discussion of false positive rates, interpretability of feature importance, and generalization to non-Korean contexts.

model_io.model: Logistic Regression (stepwise), Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Multi-Layer Perceptron
inputs: call log metadata (duration, direction, timing, operator type)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Behavioral call patterns distinguish fraudulent from legitimate phone numbers
hypotheses.result: Gradient boosting and MLP achieved >95% accuracy; identified distinctive patterns (weekday activity, short calls, high outgoing ratio, MVNO preference)

task: IoT device identification in smart grids using traffic patterns
key_results: DRID outperforms baselines across diverse sampling scenarios; captures spatiotemporal dynamics and inter-device dependencies; robust to sparse/incomplete traffic data

model_io.model: DRID (Spatiotemporal Dynamic Relational Framework)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fusing structural communication patterns and multi-scale temporal dynamics improves device identification robustness

title: Machine learning prediction and hybrid GRA–AHP optimization of AWJM parameters of ultrasonic assisted stir cast Al6061–B$$_4$$C–ZrO$$_2$$ composites
task: AWJM parameter prediction and optimization for composite machining

comments: Comprehensive experimental design with ANOVA and multi-criteria optimization; RF achieves R²=0.9882 for MRR and Ra, SVR R²=0.9955 for KTA, demonstrating robust ML predictive capability.

model_io.model: Support Vector Regression (SVR), Random Forest (RF), Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid GRA–AHP optimization identifies Pareto-optimal machining parameters
hypotheses.result: Optimal condition: AFR 430 g/min, WJP 280 MPa, AJCS 80 mm/min, SOD 1.5 mm, GS 120 mesh

title: Coexistence of liquid-like disordered state and weak ferromagnetism in a s = 1 kagome lattice
